map.D = P×(1−s)/(Y×12)；月租金 R = D + P×r/(12×1: D = P times (1 minus s) / (Y times 12); monthly rent R = D + P times r / (12 times 100) + P times m / (12 times 100)
map.基于设备租赁定价模型：月折旧 D 按原值 P、残值率 s、折旧年限 Y 直线计提: Based on an equipment rental pricing model: monthly depreciation D is straight-line from original value P, residual-rate s and depreciation years Y; monthly rent R includes depreciation plus maintenance (rate r) plus expected profit (margin m); for rental quoting and ROI assessment.
map.💡 公式：月折旧额 D = P×(1−s) / (Y×12)；月维护费 = P×: Tip: formula: monthly depreciation D = P times (1 minus s) / (Y times 12); monthly maintenance = P times r / (12 times 100); monthly rent R = D + maintenance + P times m / (12 times 100); ROI = (R times T minus P times s) / (P times s) times 100 percent (residual recovered at end).
map.月租金 = 月折旧 + 月维护费 + 月利润，未含税费与保险费: Monthly rent = monthly depreciation + monthly maintenance + monthly profit, excluding tax and insurance
map.残值率为设备期末剩余价值占比，影响折旧额与 ROI: Residual rate is the end-of-life residual value share, affecting depreciation and ROI
map.实际租赁还需考虑市场供需、设备折旧方式（直线/加速）等因素: Actual leasing also needs market supply-demand and depreciation method (straight-line / accelerated)

map.算法：残值 = 原值×残值率%；应计折旧总额 = 原值 − 残值；月折旧 = 应: Algorithm: residual value = original value times residual rate percent; depreciable amount = original value minus residual; monthly depreciation = depreciable / (depreciation years times 12); monthly maintenance = original value times maintenance rate / (12 times 100); monthly profit = original value times profit margin / (12 times 100); monthly rent = monthly depreciation + monthly maintenance + monthly profit; total rental income = monthly rent times lease months; net income = total rent + residual minus original value;
map.= 净收益/原值×100%。另给出日租金、年租金与月租费率。评级：ROI<0 亏: = net income / original value times 100 percent. Also gives daily rent, yearly rent and monthly rent rate. Grading: ROI below 0 loss, below 10 percent low return, below 30 percent reasonable, otherwise high return.
map.例：原值 50 万元、租期 24 个月、折旧 8 年、维护费率 3%、利润率 8: Example: original 500000 yuan, lease 24 months, depreciation 8 years, maintenance 3 percent, profit 8 percent, residual 5 percent gives residual 25000 yuan, monthly depreciation 4947.92 yuan, monthly maintenance 1250.00 yuan, monthly profit 3333.33 yuan, monthly rent 9531.25 yuan (monthly rent rate 1.906 percent, daily rent 317.71 yuan), total rent 228750 yuan, net income minus 246250 yuan, ROI minus 49.25 percent, graded as loss, because leasing only 2 years but depreciating over 8 years has not recovered depreciation. If lease extended to 96 months (8 years) gives total rent 915000 yuan, net income 440000 yuan, ROI 88.00 percent, graded as high return. Another: 200000 yuan, 36 months, depreciation 5 years, maintenance 2.5 percent, profit 10 percent, residual 8 percent gives monthly rent 5150.00 yuan, total rent 185400 yuan, net income 1400 yuan, ROI 0.70 percent, graded as low return.
map.为什么短期租约算出来是亏损？: Why does a short lease compute as a loss?
map.本工具的 ROI 只统计租期内的租金收入，而月折旧按整个折旧年限分摊。租期短于折: This tool's ROI only counts rent income within the lease term, while monthly depreciation is spread over the whole depreciation period; when the lease is shorter than the depreciation period, cumulative rent cannot cover the un-depreciated book value, which is normal; to evaluate long-term return include subsequent leases or resale residual.
map.利润率和维护费率怎么定？: How to set the profit margin and maintenance rate?
map.维护费率可按同类设备的年均保养支出占原值比例估算（工程机械常 2%~5%）；利润: Maintenance rate can be estimated from the annual maintenance spend of similar equipment as a share of original value (construction machinery often 2 percent to 5 percent); profit margin references industry capital cost and competition, usually 5 percent to 15 percent. Both are entered yearly and spread monthly by the tool.
map.设备租赁费率计算器，基于直线折旧法，综合维护费率与期望利润率，计算设备月租金、总: The equipment rental rate calculator, based on straight-line depreciation, integrates maintenance rate and expected profit margin to compute the monthly rent, total rental income and return on investment, aiding rental pricing decisions.
